plugins.name: Reset First
plugins.description: Routes Claude and Codex subscription requests to the account whose weekly quota resets soonest, moves accounts that use up their 5-hour or weekly limit to the end until the limit resets, and shows each account's remaining quota on a status page.
plugins.author: hosmelq

zh-CN.description: 将 Claude 与 Codex 订阅请求优先路由至每周配额最先重置的账号；用尽 5 小时或每周配额的账号会移至队尾，直到配额重置后再恢复使用，并通过状态页展示各账号的剩余配额。
